title: `teploy server backup-target show --json`: the server's stored backup target (backup-target-v1, rev 14). Never carries secret material — only whether any is stored.

has_credentials.description: Whether age-encrypted credentials are stored on the server. The envelope never carries credential values.

path.description: Server path the target was read from (/etc/teploy/backup-target.json or the ~/.config/teploy fallback).
